Hello there,
I wanted to talk about the character Jenkin, and how she could potentially be improved
upon to have better usage in the current late- to end-game.

To begin with, Jenkin’s current kit is built around giving her a high crit rate and crit damage,
and increasing her damage over time by playing her “Get ‘Em, Brown!” card and a large hit
through her “Mice Assemble”.
The primary issue with this is that her damage increase from herself is through a flat % of her
ATK stat, and nothing else. 

Due to this, her damage increase capacity is very limited in what she can do, as it takes her a while to reach damage levels that other characters can easily hit much faster with the same or less investment. The previous update to her increasing her base dmg by her equipped critical rate value and making “Get ‘Em Brown!” an aoe damage card did help with her temporary lasting ability in the game, but as it currently stands she doesn’t do enough damage to keep up with the health amounts that the newer bosses have, nor does she contribute solid assistance to teams she is on as a support character. 

Other characters that share her role as a standard DPS/carry character have found greater consistency and success in other teams or positions consistently: 
- Liz is a decent poison dps, and can be quite powerful, with fast poison application through the usage of her exalt and cards.
- Nymphaea is almost a staple on most standard poison teams at higher investments, and enables them through her exalt’s trigger.
- While Uvhash isn’t consistently used in higher difficulties of gameplay, he still has powerful scaling capabilities and has managed to still deal large amounts of damage with setup and assistance in longer stages. 
- Helot isn’t as used as a raw carry/DPS, but rather as a reliable support on Strike DMG teams, such as GHelot or Mouchette teams
- Goliath is used on more budget Lemuria/GMurphy teams, and as STR steal/support in other niche areas

Compared to these cases stated above, Jenkin has little to no usage, even with her ability to support various characters through her exalt granting the whole team a sizeable Crit DMG increase for the turn. 

So in summary, I would like to request for a rework or review of Jenkin’s abilities to deal independent damage, as it falls quite short in comparison to other characters who are meant to be performing at the same or at similar levels. While she has never been in the lowest percentage performance or in a position where she has never been used, Jenkin still has always struggled to reach more than a middling level of success.
